result.title: Geo-vision: Native-Resolution Geometry and Sampled Topology for Vehicle-Part Damage Classification
result.summary: Geo-vision classifies vehicle-part damage using a fixed representation combining appearance, multiscale geometry, orientation, and sampled digital topology. Connected components, holes, Euler characteristics, and spatial arrangement complement amplitude-sensitive pooling and a supervised tree classifier. We establish amplitude preservation, axial sign invariance, and conditional operator stability. Retrospective checkpoint evaluation on 55,303 crops from 4,916 source groups yields average precision 0.7577, exceeding 0.7458 for an ImageNet-pretrained frozen YOLO11n comparator on identical crops. The complete added structural block, comprising topology, occupancy, and component location, improves average precision by 0.00493 beyond appearance and geometry. Geo-vision uses no external encoder pretraining and has higher AP point estimates at every matched label budget. With approximately 25% fewer task labels, its AP point estimate exceeds full-data YOLO, although the adjusted interval includes zero. Complete serial CPU inference requires 26.98 ms per crop versus YOLO's 11.20 ms, with peak memory 185 versus 437 MiB. Independent external validation remains necessary.

AI.brief_summary: Geo-vision 用固定表示（外观、多尺度几何、朝向与采样数字拓扑）结合树分类器做车辆部件损伤分类，并与 ImageNet 预训练的冻结 YOLO11n 在相同裁剪上比较精度、标签效率与 CPU 推理成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于人工设计特征的视觉分类应用，不涉及多模态推理状态生成、证据获取或停止决策，也未见可供迁移到 LVR 监督或状态设计的具体机制线索，故排除。
